label: v1.20.0 — Expected Points: SKILL vs LUCK. The ± now decomposes into a TD-luck bucket (TD±, ~zero year-to-year stability) and a yards+receptions skill bucket (Eff±), plus Sustain± (the reliability-weighted, sample-shrunk part projected to carry forward — calibrated on 20 seasons of split-half reliability) and Luck± (the rest, regresses). 'vs Self' measures each player against his OWN multi-year baseline (years 1-3 use a UPS draft-slot prior that ramps to their own data), 'Backed' is the independent skill support (separation / target share / ADOT / YAC / EPA / CPOE), and 'Call' is a synthesized Buy-low / Hold / Sell-high. (v1.19.1: ± tie-out fix; v1.19.0: xFP added.)
changes_120: Horizontal scrollbar moved to the TOP of the table (synced two-way); the table now scrolls in a bounded 680px region so the scrollbar + column header stay fixed while the body scrolls (works in the iframe embed, not just standalone).
Pos Rk now ranks within the IDP/offense GROUP (DL/LB/DB/QB/RB/WR/TE/PK) instead of the raw nflverse position — fixes multiple #1s showing in a single DL/LB/DB.
description: The Advanced Stats Workbench gains a rank-within-position column (by MFL PPG, matching the mobile app), a coverage line that flags the 500-row cap and offseason, a 'Full profile' button in the drill-down drawer that opens the shared UPS player-profile modal, search by name/team/position, and a responsive layout for tablet/large-phone embeds. The leaderboard is also now available on the mobile site (focused per-position view).
